minimum_operation_review.observations_distinct: Empty verifies issuance predicate; current authenticates stage-appropriate state; prepared verifies exact original receipt/artifacts for handoff. All share one complete snapshot schema, never a generic file-read API.
minimum_operation_review.cleanup_split: BEGIN_CLEANUP must preempt without waiting for active effect completion; CLEANUP_AND_REPORT completes bounded teardown/evidence. Both belong to one monotonic cleanup duty.

bounds.attempt_budget_scope: One monotonic 5000ms deadline starts at materialization admission and includes materialize, compile, in-attempt observations and intervening time; never reset per operation. Outer preparation attempt hard timeout 10000ms. Total outer stdout/stderr each <=8192 over all attempt frames, not 8192 per unlimited frame. Retained lifetime is not this attempt budget and confers no indefinite readiness.

cleanup.explicit_retry_scope: bounded same original identity only; permanent invalidity

bounds.limit_rule: All limits are ceilings, never permission to expand PREP/SANDBOX.2. Full metadata/inventory exceeding any bound is incomplete, never a truncated successful snapshot. All tasks/threads count against pids128; no first-N process sample. Timeout/overflow denies success and invokes bounded cleanup.
bounds.retention: Exclusive workspace remains only until completion/abort/timeout/abandonment/upstream loss. No new retained lifetime numeric duration is preauthorized; future owner must enforce separately reviewed bounded lifetime policy before readiness.

workspace_state_digest.framing: ASCII domain + NUL + ASCII fixed role + NUL + strict canonical payload bytes using authentication.canonical_types and authentication.canonical_encoding
workspace_state_digest.identity_fields: Exact retained originals and current generation/sequence/challenge; all must match the enclosing workspace-current-state HMAC and current owner registry.
workspace_state_digest.stage: preparation-empty, materialized or prepared is derived only from authenticated initial state or the original preparation owner's same-attempt evidence. Partial/failed operations confer no prepared readiness. No harness stage is authorized.
workspace_state_digest.mounts: Exactly two ordered records /tmp then /work: path, observed mount identity and namespace/generation, filesystem kind=tmpfs, exact frozen options, subordinate_mount_count=0. Include authenticated root identity/metadata; missing or unproved mount relation fails closed.
workspace_state_digest.manifest_scope: Complete descriptor-relative no-follow recursive entries beneath each authenticated root, including directories; roots are in mounts. Paths are exact absolute POSIX paths, sorted by UTF-8 path bytes, unique, without dot/parent/alias/NUL/backslash components. Each regular file has exact integer byte size, complete content SHA256 and link_count=1. Directory size_bytes and sha256 are null; directories have observed integer metadata and are never followed through links or other mounts. Links/special files are rejected, not omitted or normalized into regular entries.
workspace_state_digest.work_manifest: Empty at workspace readiness. Thereafter inherit only PREP's stage-appropriate exact /work/SyntheticStateBox.java, /work/classes directory, and /work/classes/SyntheticStateBox.class, with full source/readback and bounded class size/hash checks from the unchanged preparation owner. No predicted class hash or extra artifact is accepted.
workspace_state_digest.tmp_manifest: Complete no-follow manifest under /tmp with the same entry schema plus its exact mount. Preparation-empty contains no inputs or artifacts; later allowed infrastructure-only entries, if any, require a separately reviewed closed fixed controller operation and never supply compiler inputs. Unknown entries or unproved /tmp closure abort; no generic metadata exception or harness addition is preauthorized.
workspace_state_digest.process_exclusivity_observation: Authenticate exact controller/process namespace/generation, full bounded process/writer inventory and descendant/operation identities, exclusive owner or exact authorized borrower, absence of shared writers/target JVM/target activation, and no cleanup barrier. Unexpected processes/writers or an incomplete inventory abort readiness. Later consumer observation/activation requires its separate contract; this digest grants none.
workspace_state_digest.authenticated_by: workspace-current-state HMAC covers this digest, fixed algorithm/domain/role/scope identity, same observation/generation binding and current predicates; original full observations remain bound in the owner registry. A scalar digest or replayed manifest never establishes readiness.

required_observations: regular file sizes and full SHA256

owner_challenge.sequence: strictly owner-monotonic for original live relation; never reset/wrap within generation
owner_challenge.verification: Owner matches outstanding exact operation/purpose/generations/sequence/challenge and original object/controller relation before independently authenticating full observations. No caller challenge and no replay.

observations.continuity_limit: Fresh challenge proves current response only by separately authenticated exact retained controller relation. Backend route/version/name equality and cryptographic freshness do not prove daemon continuity or eliminate ABA; unobservable generation continuity is PROOF_UNRESOLVED.
observations.tmp_entries_policy: No /tmp infrastructure entries are accepted by this protocol. Nonempty /tmp invalidates its closed input envelope; any future exception needs a separately reviewed fixed operation and cannot become compiler input.

frozen_effect.workspace_kind: already-authorized container-local ephemeral tmpfs; never host repository or bind mount
frozen_effect.initial_workspace: empty, exclusively owned by one attempt; no image volume, host mount, shared writer, preexisting source/class or other Java input
frozen_effect.file_count_scope: /work source/output workspace; /tmp is separately bounded by the exact SANDBOX.2 tmpfs policy and must contain no compiler input, exported artifact or retained file after teardown
frozen_effect.symlink_policy: Allow only the independently verified expected /work tmpfs root mount; reject unexpected/subordinate mount crossings, symlinks, hardlink aliases and special files at destination/output and workspace path components. lstat/descriptor-relative no-follow checks, exclusive creation and single-link regular file readback; no path re-resolution race or shared writer.
frozen_effect.path_policy: No caller path; exact absolute POSIX allowlist. Reject NUL, backslash, dot/parent components, path aliases, traversal, unexpected entries and root escapes before any write.
frozen_effect.overwrite_policy: Never overwrite or truncate existing paths; binary exclusive creation only. Existing file/directory conflicts abort the attempt, including byte-identical files.
frozen_effect.byte_policy: Copy existing exact frozen bytes only, full size/hash and byte-for-byte readback; no encoding/newline conversion, regeneration, formatting or rewriting.

compiler.template_derivation: Recover every flag and output path unchanged from JAVA.1C; explicitly freeze only the scenario source operand substitution as new scope. Historical invocation, controller and provider remain unchanged and cannot perform this operation.
compiler.input_closure: Only the exact frozen source and immutable pinned JDK/image; no class/JAR/processor/service/config inputs in initially empty cwd or writable tmpfs, no source imports/annotations, no caller CLASSPATH/JDK_JAVAC_OPTIONS/JAVA_TOOL_OPTIONS/_JAVA_OPTIONS. Do not invent -proc:none or other flags.

compile_output.bound_basis: Adopt the frozen JAVA.1C 1..32768 single-class envelope; scenario class bytes/size/hash have not been measured.
compile_output.manifest: Full sorted no-follow workspace manifest: exact directory/file types, paths, sizes, SHA256 for source and class, no extra files, same source bytes before/after. Parse bounded classfile metadata as inert data to check internal class identity; never load it for verification.
compile_output.unexpected_file_behavior: COMPILE_OUTPUT_MISMATCH; publish no ready receipt, revoke preparation eligibility, tear down entire attempt workspace. No selective retention, new flags, retry or fallback.

compilation.revalidate: Immediately before launch, exact same-attempt source/readback/manifest and original generations under local fence plus separately authenticated owner admission. If owner ISSUED continuity at effect cannot be observed, PROOF_UNRESOLVED before launch.
compilation.postprocess: Fully reap compiler and observe both EOFs; verify unchanged source and exact single-class envelope; full class hash and inert bounded classfile metadata identity only. No target load/link/initialize, JVM dispatch, reflection or SyntheticStateBox instance.

handoff.current_admission: No consumer contract/borrower authenticator exists, so current request cannot establish reservation or activation. Freeze conditional semantics only, never a placeholder borrower token.

serialization.snapshot_boundary: Acquire local fence, verify exact generations and owner admission, inspect complete state without mutation/writer race, bind result to same fence epoch. If coherence cannot be observed fail unresolved; read-only inventory is not an external writer lock.
serialization.active_on_cleanup: Set barrier and revoke success publication under fence first; cancel/terminate active child group or write, fully reap, close/EOF captures, cancel reservation, then continue outer teardown. Never publish raced readiness. Cleanup bypasses BUSY.
serialization.duplicate_or_replay: Reject repeated operation/request/admission IDs, consumed challenges and stale sequences. Never rerun a mutation even if previous response lost; mark outcome unresolved and clean. Cleanup barrier/teardown may be re-observed with a fresh cleanup request and bounded same-identity retry only.

outer.owner_role: independently authorized fixed host/control-plane cleanup custodian
outer.target: Retained authenticated immutable full original container ID/backend and workspace/controller generation relation, never name or caller ID alone; independently prove safe targeting on current control plane or fail unresolved.
outer.bounds: Fixed 10000ms invocation deadline and <=8192-byte bounded response, no automatic retry. Explicit same-identity cleanup retry never restores readiness.
outer.absence: Fresh independent exact same-backend full-ID inspect/absence observation with authenticated observer identity/method and generation relation. Removal exit status, transient inspect failure, name absence or inner self-report alone insufficient.
outer.lost_inner_evidence: Kill/remove/absence must still be attempted safely after inner loss. Unknown child/group reap or capture EOF stays unresolved even if container absent; never fabricate composite cleanup success.

framing.canonical_types: Exact schema-defined str/int/bool/None/list/dict types only; bool is not int. String keys only; reject missing/extra fields, duplicate keys, unsupported types, nonfinite numbers and implicit coercion. No caller JSON restore path exists.
framing.canonical_payload_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false; schema-defined list order, no normalization or default=str
framing.framing_requirement: Exactly one length-delimited canonical typed payload per request/response with unambiguous length/version/endpoint relation. Concrete transport prefix/encoding is deferred; reject overlong, trailing, partial, duplicate, unexpected or multiplexed frames before any effect. Never caller text commands.

primitive_rules.id: exact str, nonempty, <=256 UTF-8 bytes, no NUL; reference only to authenticated original relation, never restore authority from string
primitive_rules.positive_int: exact int in 1..9223372036854775807; bool rejected; no wrap/reuse
primitive_rules.challenge: exact str, 64 lowercase hex chars from owner 32 unpredictable bytes; required for three observation tags; null for other tags, whose admission still binds final observation
primitive_rules.json: Reject duplicate/missing/unknown keys at every nesting, nonfinite/float values, unknown enum, coercion and unsupported types; exact schema str/int/bool/null/list/dict only.

framing.nested_schema_rule: message_schema.json freezes every exact closed nested record and cross-field predicate as declarative data. Workspace state uses unchanged digest payload fields plus the full mount/manifest/process source observations within those fields. No raw source/class/capture bytes or arbitrary maps. Wire transport prefix remains deferred; semantic schemas are frozen here.
framing.success_rule: COMPLETE requires exactly complete bounded operation-specific evidence, null error, matched IDs/generations/sequence/challenge/purpose, and all postconditions. Other statuses carry exact typed error and null result, except cleanup operations may carry bounded partial cleanup evidence with explicit unresolved components. Partial cleanup evidence never claims completion/readiness. COMPLETE never means owner readiness or behavior success; BEGIN_CLEANUP completion only means barrier recorded.

error_fields.detail_id: closed controller reason enum in message_schema.json

original_workspace_authentication.registry: Exact process-local registry retains the original workspace object, immutable signed payload, original graph/controller references, monotonic observations and permanent terminal tombstones; full type and identity checks precede accepting its projection.
original_workspace_authentication.canonical_types: Exact schema-defined str/int/bool/None/list/dict types only; bool is not int. String keys only; reject missing/extra fields, duplicate keys, unsupported types, nonfinite numbers and implicit coercion. No caller JSON restore path exists.
original_workspace_authentication.canonical_encoding: UTF-8 JSON with sort_keys=true, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=true, allow_nan=false; schema-defined list order, no normalization or default=str
original_workspace_authentication.framing: ASCII domain + NUL + ASCII fixed role + NUL + canonical payload bytes
original_workspace_authentication.identity_hmac_payload: immutable signed bindings; signed payload retains the independently computed stable fingerprint
original_workspace_authentication.stable_fingerprint: SHA256(domain + NUL + 'workspace-identity' + NUL + canonical immutable identity payload excluding signature and fingerprint); public report digest is never authentication
original_workspace_authentication.state_hmac_payload: workspace ID/stable fingerprint/issuing PID + exact original graph/controller binding + generation + owner-monotonic sequence + fresh owner challenge + all current predicates/state digest + operation/handoff ID + cleanup barrier; signs no authority permission
original_workspace_authentication.freshness: Require current owner registry sequence and a current challenge response from the exact retained controller for the guarded operation. Cached HMACs, a timestamp, unchanged digest, container name or route/version equality alone cannot establish current readiness.
original_workspace_authentication.validation: Compare HMAC in constant time and match canonical originally retained bytes. Reauthenticate every retained upstream through its unchanged public validator. Then evaluate current eligibility independently of historical authenticity.
original_workspace_authentication.cleanup_only_exception: Fresh readiness/challenge and successful current upstream reauthentication are operation admission requirements, not prerequisites for mandatory teardown. After controller loss or upstream invalidity use retained authenticated immutable cleanup identity and the independently authorized fixed teardown/absence path; it never restores readiness.

authentication.controller_evidence: Only semantics frozen: exact original source/executable/protocol/incarnation/host/container/generation/transport/bootstrap/configuration and bounded observations; independently authenticated by future workspace owner. No separately signed controller receipt type or issuer is required/frozen here, and none is issued.

errors.classification: Controller authentication/source/executable/protocol/generation failures describe controller layer only. Existing provider/workspace/preparation/runtime semantic failures retain original layer and exact typed code; never rebrand as CONTROLLER_UNAUTHENTICATED.
errors.busy_exception: CONTROLLER_BUSY applies to ordinary operations only, never BEGIN_CLEANUP/mandatory teardown.
errors.observation_failure: Incomplete full inventory/capture/coherence/response is failure, never ready. Unobservable owner/generation continuity is PROOF_UNRESOLVED.
errors.cleanup_mapping: Keep CONTROLLER_CLEANUP_UNRESOLVED evidence separate; workspace owner may report its existing WORKSPACE_CLEANUP_UNRESOLVED without erasing root cause.

effect_counter_scope: Required zero by design plus measured pure-validation guards; described future effects are not run or issued by this phase.
